scripts.preinstall: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const ua=process.env.npm_config_user_agent||''; for (const f of ['package-lock.json','yarn.lock']) { try { fs.rmSync(f, { force: true }); } catch {} } if (!ua.startsWith('pnpm/')) { console.error('Use pnpm instead'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.eas:android: corepack pnpm --dir mobile exec eas build -p android --profile preview
scripts.build: corepack pnpm run typecheck && corepack pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm run typecheck:libs && corepack pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./mobile" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
